# Illustrative rates for the example only — not market quotes; supply your own.
#
# Fabrication and supply rates for vessel_designer.core.barge_cost. Every number here is a
# round placeholder chosen to make the example run. Do not use it for a budget or a bid.
# Copy this file, put in rates from your own yard quotes, and pass it in:
#
#     from vessel_designer.core.barge_cost import BargeCostInputs, compute
#     result = compute(BargeCostInputs(), rates="my_rates.yaml")
#
# Units: "_rate" is currency per tonne of the matching mass unless stated; "_lump" is per
# ATB unit (barge + tug); "yard_margin_fraction" is a fraction of the barge + tug subtotal.

currency: USD

# --- barge fabrication / supply (per tonne) ---
hull_steel_rate: 2500.0          # fabricated hull structure; also used for the tug hull
tank_shell_rate: 10000.0         # Type-C pressure-vessel shell and heads
tank_supports_rate: 2000.0       # saddles, anti-flotation, internals
insulation_rate: 4000.0          # installed insulation system, per tonne equivalent
piping_rate: 4500.0              # piping and machinery
outfitting_rate: 4000.0

# --- cargo system (lump sums per unit) ---
cargo_system_lump: 500000.0      # pumps, manifold, ESD, relief, gauging
paint_anodes_misc: 100000.0

# --- electric pusher tug ---
battery_rate_per_kwh: 250.0      # per kWh installed
propulsion_rate_per_kw: 1000.0   # per kW installed: thrusters, drives, switchboard
wheelhouse_accom_lump: 450000.0  # wheelhouse, crew spaces, navigation and controls
tug_outfitting_lump: 200000.0

# --- yard and delivery ---
yard_margin_fraction: 0.10       # engineering, class, trials, margin
delivery_lump: 200000.0          # delivery voyage or heavy-lift, per unit
